title: Improve area chart type in `st.metric`
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary The area chart on `st.metric` could be improved by 1) removing the bottom padding 2) allowing the axis to better adjust to the given data, like its done with the line chart type. With the current state, its very hard to see changes in data if the numbers are relatively high. ### Why? _No response_ ### How? On the bottom padding: Just make sure charts of all types are all the exact same height, but then inside Vega Lite add extra padding in the line/bar charts to make them look better. ### Additional Context _No response_
